answers.responseText: Tally strategy by repeated addition: use the y-block as a counter. On each pass, erase one 1 from y, then run the boxed x+y adder to append a copy of x to a separate accumulator block on the right. When y is empty, erase the leftover separators, leaving the accumulator as the single output block, and walk right to standard position.

Reserve the leftmost block of the tape as an opcode: 1 = successor, 11 = addition, 111 = multiplication. The machine first walks left, counts the opcode block, erases it, and branches into the corresponding boxed submachine (the earlier successor and addition solutions, and the multiplication strategy from Problem 10); each ends in standard position.
